title: 2 dead, 5 injured in shooting at Seattle Center during food festival: Officials
description: Two people are dead and five others are injured after shots rang out at the Bite of Seattle food festival at the Seattle Center on Sunday, according to officials.

title: The wellness trap: How dangerous products keep targeting women
description: History has shown a persistent pattern of women being targeted by products that carry underlying risks including everything from early cosmetics and pharmaceuticals, to today’s latest popular weight loss drugs. The growing awareness of these concerns has fueled public scrutiny, legal action, calls for stronger safety standards, greater transparency, and increased accountability from manufacturers.
